programs.description: Arddhanaari, a man under the guise of a transgender individual, enters a city and begins to kill people, especially the government employees. Eventually, when he is caught, he shares a menacing story.
Four friends end up staying in an ancestral house which is haunted by the spirit of Urmila. By the time they realise the truth about the house, things start getting worse.
Ambu, a carefree college student, falls in love with a woman he sees at a bus stop. However, before he can confess his feelings, unexpected complications arise.
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.
Radha and Krishna are lovers who must face various challenges as they attempt to reunite after a curse separates them for a hundred years.
Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.
Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
Bringing the best in cinema.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.
Ullas schemes to marry Simran, a woman with a disability, to avoid repaying a debt, but faces complications when Laya, a wealthy alcoholic, enters his life, turning his plans upside down.
